newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei struggles back up to 21,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei struggles back up to 21,000 level.

text.p: Tokyo's Nikkei struggled back up to the 21,000 level by the end of Wednesday trade, after being battered throughout the day by bouts of selling, brokers said. They said the recovery was due largely to investors who bought back stocks after selling off bonds before the session ended.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 closed down 41.53 points or 0.20 percent at 21,082.15. Its December futures were down 70 points at 21,100.
"The Nikkei average is stuck in a box around the 21,000 level and will stay so until the political scenery clears," said Masayuki Matsumoto, a Daiichi Securities analyst.
